protocol.model: Same CausalGraphQueue, hidden 32, 20076 parameters; only spatial operators differ
protocol.inputs: Same nine legal past/current channels, supplied condition and public FD geometry
protocol.labels: Same noisy public-train observation labels and source event metadata
protocol.loss: Same equal-event BCE positive weight 4 + .1 speed MAE; onset classification at final step only
protocol.checkpoint: Corrected domain-condition event Brier every five epochs; same rule for all three ranges
protocol.selection: Checkpoint, range, mixture and conditional threshold/nonempty decision by calibration only; seal before assessment loading
protocol.physics_limit: Travel-time neighborhoods are a representation. Repeated layers/GroupNorm do not enforce a hard propagation cone.
protocol.promotion: Same original Queue gate: >=.01 proxy gain with positive day-block CI on two folds/directions, no direction loss >.01, multiple fit seeds

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

sampler.label_provenance: eligible noisy public train observations; unknown future cells omitted

selected_comparison.limitation: Observed-proxy event sampling only. Days with zero events remain in bootstrap. Draws missing a condition are excluded; sparse event sets make this interval weak. No formal Queue score.

source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: One direction/fold/fit seed, public noisy proxy labels. Same sequence inputs/loss/budget across three spatial ranges. Spatial reach is not a strict wave cone. Assessment dates were already inspected development dates. No formal Queue claim.
